projects.title: Website Penjualan Rumah (HouseING Property)
projects.description: Mengembangkan platform pencarian dan simulasi properti modern berbasis Angular Standalone Components dan TypeScript strict. Memanfaatkan keunggulan Angular Signals (signal, computed, effect) untuk manajemen reaktivitas state berkecepatan tinggi tanpa overhead Zone.js berlebih, sinkronisasi kalkulator simulasi KPR formula anuitas perbankan secara real-time, penjelajahan denah arsitektur 2D interaktif (multi-floor switcher dan visual orientasi kompas) pada 60 FPS, serta pengurutan data properti instan.

projects.title: Website Prediksi Siklon Tropis (LSTM Forecasting)
projects.description: Aplikasi web prediksi lintasan siklon tropis berbasis riset skripsi dengan arsitektur Deep Learning LSTM menggunakan data IBTrACS (1980–2025). Menguji 12 skenario eksperimen komparatif pada 3 domain perairan (North Indian, South Indian, Gabungan) dengan 4 variasi sliding window (8, 16, 24, 32 timesteps). Konfigurasi GAB-8 mencapai akurasi tertinggi dengan MAE 0,127405°, RMSE 0,144091°, dan Mean Haversine Distance 15,885 km, diintegrasikan ke dalam visualisasi geospasial interaktif sebagai sistem pendukung keputusan mitigasi bencana di pesisir Sumatera Barat.

Utilized Angular Signals (signal, computed, effect) to model fine-grained reactive state, enabling real-time annuity-based mortgage calculation, multi-attribute facet filtering, and interactive 2D architectural blueprint rendering with floor switching.

projects.title: Tropical Cyclone LSTM Forecasting Platform
projects.description: Engineered an interactive geospatial web platform based on undergraduate thesis research utilizing Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) recurrent neural networks for tropical cyclone track forecasting with IBTrACS data (1980–2025). Evaluated 12 empirical scenarios across 3 oceanic domains (NI, SI, Combined) and 4 sliding window configurations (8, 16, 24, 32 timesteps), establishing that the Combined 8-timestep model (GAB-8) achieved optimal trajectory fidelity (MAE: 0.127405°, RMSE: 0.144091°, Mean Haversine Distance: 15.885 km) to support early warning and disaster risk mitigation in West Sumatra.
